## 4cd908d8def2

**Reproduced shortcut defect — foreground cell count replaces the intended dihedral-shape match.** Audited generator SHA-256: `fbd9d84b67339d86707401d4f77d31680363c847569161b73e3769041fb8115c`.

The generator makes the true matching panel preserve the template's foreground-cell count, while every distractor is forced to use `template_count + {-1,+1,+2}` cells. Therefore a solver can ignore rotation/reflection and return the first candidate with the same nonzero-cell count as panel 0. On 60 deterministic production draws (20 each for easy/medium/hard, seed `20261019`), every input passed `self_check`, exactly one candidate shared the template count, and the count-only shortcut matched all 60 canonical Racket outputs. See `checks/audit/4cd908d8def2/python-shortcut.json`, `racket-60.json`, and `comparison.json`; the reusable probe is `checks/audit/4cd908d8def2/probe_equal_count_shortcut.py`.

This shortcut is not faithful to the canonical support: canonical examples include same-count nonmatching candidates, forcing actual shape-equivalence reasoning. The strict audit also found no task-local tests and no semantic contract; see `checks/audit/4cd908d8def2-combined/`. Suggested repair: sample at least one same-count, non-D4-equivalent distractor in every lesson and declare an executable count-only rival. Audit only; no source was changed.
